messages:
Maya: Customer asked for a Console flow to diagnose "expensive tails": show est spend by tenant + link to traces and error analytics. Minimal SDK change requested.
Liam: Clarify scope: do they need model/route split, or per-request granularity?
Maya: They want model+route+tenant level, and ability to click into example requests that drove spend.
Priya: Tech approach: tag root span with `tenant_hash`, `model_variant`, `route`, `est_cost_usd` and add `error_flag:true` when request errored. Emit a compact telemetry row for exports.
Noah: Sampling: keep global low rate. Add dynamic sampler: force-collect 100% for requests where `est_cost_usd` > $threshold OR `error_flag` true OR tenant in beta list. Need retention caps for non-beta tenants to control cost.
Dina: UI: top-table "Estimated spenders" with pivots (model/route), an "Errors" mini-panel showing error rate by model for selected tenant, and a drill action "Open example trace". Tooltip: "Estimate at request time; final billing may differ."
Zoe: Add a small inline timeline showing spikes and overlay error counts so SREs can correlate. Also a quick filter to show only traces with `est_cost_usd` > X.
Maya: Exporting: customers asked for BigQuery export of the telemetry rows for reconciliation. Exports off by default and opt-in for enterprise.
Liam: I'll own export schema: `event_ts, tenant_hash, model_variant, route, tokens_est, est_cost_usd, trace_id, batch_id, error_flag`. Versioned and gated.
Priya: SDK changes: optional `obs` param and a tiny shim to set tags automatically when missing. Languages: py/ts/go first. Backcompat maintained.
Noah: Infra: 1 week to add dynamic sampling and retention caps; 1-2w to add low-cost hot path for high-sample tenants. We must add an SLO and a budget alert for ingestion cost.
Dina: Privacy/legal: hashed tenant only, no PII. Exports require signed agreement. I'll coordinate legal review and opt-in policy.
Maya: Acceptance criteria for beta: 1) Console table + pivot and error mini-panel, 2) drill-to-trace with cost tags visible, 3) export opt-in populates BigQuery sample rows, 4) runbook for disabling high-sample path.
Zoe: Success metrics: median est_vs_billing delta <20% for top 30 tenants, reduction in mean time-to-detect expensive regressions by 50% in beta, dashboard median latency <300ms.
Priya: Phases: Phase A = add tags (hotfix), Phase B = dashboard + dynamic sampling + internal beta, Phase C = export opt-in + GA + SDK polish.
Liam: Risks: cost drift due to batching; we'll surface `batch_id` and reconcile nightly. Also audit logs for export access.
Noah: Operational play: add oncall runbook steps: 1) toggle off high-sample flag, 2) disable export, 3) reach out to tenant owner. I'll draft the playbook.
Dina: Owners: Maya (PM), Priya (SDK & collector), Noah (ingest/sampling & ops), Liam (export/schema), Zoe (UX), Dina (legal & launch checklist).
Maya: I'll schedule a 30m to align epics and land tickets. Thanks.
oncall-bot: Created action OBS-1101 "Expensive-tail diagnosis flow" assigned to Maya, Priya, Noah, Liam, Zoe, Dina."
